-- First, let's identify stars that have at least one planet and find which ones have ONLY rocky planets
WITH star_planet_types AS (
    SELECT 
        s.stellarref,
        p.planetref,
        pp.densvalue,
        CASE WHEN pp.densvalue > 3 THEN 'rocky' ELSE 'not_rocky' END as planet_type
    FROM stars s
    JOIN planets p ON s.stellarref = p.hostlink
    JOIN physical_properties pp ON p.planetref = pp.objectlink

FROM stars s
JOIN stars_with_only_rocky sor ON s.stellarref = sor.stellarref
WHERE s.stellarprops->>'Opt_Mag' IS NOT NULL
